hook_text: 50 000 minus 23 476. Four zeros in a row. There is a trick that skips all the exchanging.
clip_script: A music festival in Bloemfontein. 24 586 people on Saturday, 18 937 on Sunday. Altogether? Line up on the right. Units: 6 plus 7 is 13, write 3, carry 1. Keep going left: 43 523. Guess check: 25 000 plus 19 000 is 44 000. Close. Now the scary one: 50 000 minus 23 476. Zeros everywhere. Trick: take away from 49 999 instead. No exchanging: 26 523. You took from a number 1 smaller, so add 1 back. 26 524. Check: 23 476 plus 26 524 is 50 000. Line up, carry, exchange, and always check.
visual_style: Column sums written on a whiteboard, with carried digits popping up in a different colour and a 50 000 turning into 49 999 plus 1.
mood: Confident, like a festival cashier counting the gate money.
pacing: One steady column sum, then the zero trick revealed, then the check.
call_to_action: Watch the full lesson and work out 70 000 minus 31 258 with the trick.
